Override.Name: Override World Settings
Override.Hint: Use custom fog shading values for this scene instead of the module's world settings. Changes preview live on the canvas while this scene is being viewed.

Enabled.Name: Enable Fog Shading
Enabled.Hint: Turn off to fall back to Foundry's default fog rendering (applies instantly, handy for comparing).

UnexploredDarkness.Name: Unexplored: Darkness
UnexploredDarkness.Hint: How dark never-explored areas are. 0 = full map brightness, 1 = solid black (Foundry default).

UnexploredSaturation.Name: Unexplored: Saturation
UnexploredSaturation.Hint: Colour saturation of never-explored areas. 0 = greyscale, 1 = original colours.

UnexploredTint.Name: Unexplored: Tint Colour
UnexploredTint.Hint: Colour used to tint never-explored areas.

UnexploredTintStrength.Name: Unexplored: Tint Strength
UnexploredTintStrength.Hint: How strongly the tint colour is applied. 0 = no tint.

ExploredDarkness.Name: Explored: Darkness
ExploredDarkness.Hint: How dark explored areas that are not currently in sight are. 0 = full map brightness, 1 = solid black.

ExploredSaturation.Name: Explored: Saturation
ExploredSaturation.Hint: Colour saturation of explored areas not currently in sight. 0 = greyscale, 1 = original colours.

ExploredTint.Name: Explored: Tint Colour
ExploredTint.Hint: Colour used to tint explored areas not currently in sight.

ExploredTintStrength.Name: Explored: Tint Strength
ExploredTintStrength.Hint: How strongly the tint colour is applied. 0 = no tint.

SceneDarknessInfluence.Name: Follow Scene Darkness
SceneDarknessInfluence.Hint: How much the scene's darkness level further darkens fogged areas, so night scenes don't show brighter fog than lit areas. 0 = ignore scene darkness.

UseFogImage.Name: Prefer Fog Images When Set
UseFogImage.Hint: If a Scene or Level has a Fog of War image configured, use it for unexplored areas instead of the shaded map.

NeverFog.Name: Never Fog Outside Buildings
NeverFog.Hint: Only buildings you're inside get fog. Everywhere else the map is always shown (tokens still need line of sight, and fog memory is unaffected). A building is any tile with a Fade, Radial or Vision occlusion mode: while that roof tile is faded, the area under it gets normal fog.

OwnRoofFade.Name: Roofs Fade Only For Your Tokens
OwnRoofFade.Hint: Only tokens you control (GM) or own (players) fade roofs. Off = Foundry's default, where any token you can see also fades the roof above it, e.g. an NPC seen through an open door.

RevealedDarkness.Name: Never Fog: Darkness
RevealedDarkness.Hint: How dark always-shown areas are when outside your line of sight. 0 = full map brightness.

RevealedSaturation.Name: Never Fog: Saturation
RevealedSaturation.Hint: Colour saturation of always-shown areas outside your line of sight. 0 = greyscale, 1 = original colours.

RoofLevel.Name: Roof Level (Fog Shading)
RoofLevel.Hint: Treat this Level's background as a roof: the whole image fades while a token is under any of its opaque pixels (see Alpha Threshold), like a Fade-mode roof tile. With Never Fog enabled, the area under the roof gets normal fog while it's faded. Best for a single building; use roof tiles for separate buildings.
